name: azure-databricks
description: Expert knowledge for Azure Databricks development including troubleshooting, best practices, decision making, architecture & design patterns, limits & quotas, security, configuration, integrations & coding patterns, and deployment. Use when working with Unity Catalog, Lakeflow pipelines, Lakebase, AI Runtime/MLflow, or Databricks agents, and other Azure Databricks related development tasks. Not for Azure Synapse Analytics (use azure-synapse-analytics), Azure HDInsight (use azure-hdinsight), Azure Machine Learning (use azure-machine-learning), Azure Data Factory (use azure-data-factory).
